assumptions.op_amp_model: ideal; Q1 device electrical behavior is NOT simulated
assumptions.filter_capacitors: C1a/C1b/C2/C3/C4 MKP 5%; C5 C0G 5% design condition

limitations: Not SPICE and not a measured circuit: ideal op amps and stiff VDDA.
No op-amp offset/bias/noise/bandwidth, output swing or saturation recovery.
No protection, ESD, unpowered/back-power states or ignition transients.
No ADC sampling-switch/current model; output RC is continuous-time only.
Hypothetical SUM capacitance lumps layout/op-amp effects; no measured C.
Corners are component bounds, not a complete uncertainty/accuracy budget.
Resistor voltage/temperature coefficients and self-heating are not included.
Capacitor dielectric loss, temperature/voltage dependence, ESL/ESR and layout are not included.
Pickup is normalized small-signal Cs/Cg/R sensitivity; not ignition kV.
BNC is DC biased when open; its Thevenin resistance is not grounded.
Rail margins below are only against ideal 0..VDDA, not op-amp linear limits.

own_rail_dc_test.zero: CH1 directly jumpered to AGND; pot bottom through 1k is not zero
own_rail_dc_test.meter_actual_spec: 10Mohm example; RM101/RM102 manual lists 10Mohm for DC voltage, actual unit/range/condition not verified
own_rail_dc_test.does_not_cover: wiring error, missing ground, pot failure, wrong component, external source

pickup_sensitivity.meaning: Normalized incremental response after a hypothetical source step

filter.topology: low-Q unity Sallen-Key first, high-Q second, 330ohm/1nF last
filter.corners_scope: 2^11 physical-part corners; R5...R9 ±1%; independent C1a/C1b/C2/C3/C4 MKP ±5%, C5 C0G ±5%; nominal SUM capacitance/Rth; ideal op amps

largest_peak_among_corners.search: numerical stationary points of |H|^-2 polynomial in (f/1000)^2, plus DC/10kHz; not real-circuit stability

step_at_largest_frequency_peak_corner.selection: largest frequency-response peak among listed R/C corners
